environment.description: ECS Fargate task in isolated private subnet with VPC endpoints for SQS only. The SQS queue has a resource policy with aws:SourceVpce condition restricting SendMessage to vpc-endpoint vpce-0a1b2c3d4e (the application VPC endpoint) and the deployment pipeline role arn:aws:iam::111222333444:role/deploy-pipeline only. Origin content is served exclusively through CloudFront distribution d1234abcdef8.cloudfront.net configured with a custom Origin Access Control (OAC) policy; the S3 bucket policy denies all access except from the CloudFront distribution's service principal with matching distribution ID condition. CloudFront behaviors require signed URLs using key group kg-9f8e7d6c with RSA-2048 key pair kp-abc123, with a URL signature validity window of 300 seconds. The Fargate task's security group allows outbound only to the SQS VPC endpoint prefix list (pl-63a5400a) and the CloudFront managed prefix list (com.amazonaws.global.cloudfront.origin-facing) on port 443. NAT gateway is NOT provisioned; there is no internet-routable egress path from the task subnet.

config.s3_bucket_policy: Deny all except Principal: cloudfront.amazonaws.com with StringEquals aws:SourceArn=arn:aws:cloudfront::111222333444:distribution/d1234abcdef8
config.cloudfront_oac: Origin Access Control with signing behavior ALWAYS, origin type S3
config.cloudfront_signed_urls: Key group kg-9f8e7d6c, key pair kp-abc123, validity 300s
config.network_egress: Security group outbound: pl-63a5400a:443 (SQS VPCE), com.amazonaws.global.cloudfront.origin-facing:443 only
